reason: User requested research into pausing Google Play system updates after native network module boot failures.
expected_effect: Reject new Play Store staged sessions and non-staged APEX installation through the platform allowlist.
limits: No device changes, reboot, session cancellation, or APEX removal is performed by the generator.
Existing READY sessions require a fresh audit before any deployment.
Ordinary non-staged APK module updates and download attempts are not guaranteed to stop.
Root, system, shell and privileged bypass paths are outside this selective Play installer restriction.
Runtime verification of rejection and ordinary Play application updates is still required.
Future donor firmware requires renewed framework and configuration review.
